meta.name: coding-standards
meta.description: Universal coding standards, best practices, and patterns for TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Node.js development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 遵循编码规范与最佳实践来编写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在项目中统一代码风格和规范。
copy.tagline_en: Write code following coding standards and best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce consistent coding standards in your project.

howto.what: Claude 会遵循 TypeScript、JavaScript、React 和 Node.js 的编码规范，包括命名、不可变性、错误处理、类型安全、组件结构、自定义 Hook、状态管理、API 设计、文件组织、注释、性能优化和测试标准。
howto.when: 当你开始新项目、审查代码、重构、设置 lint 规则或指导新成员时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段 React 组件的代码质量。
say.note: Claude 会检查组件是否符合 React 最佳实践。

say.text: 按照编码规范重构这个函数。
say.note: Claude 会应用命名、不可变性等规则。

say.text: 为这个 API 端点设计符合规范的响应格式。
say.note: Claude 会使用 ApiResponse 接口。

howto.what_en: Claude will enforce coding standards for TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Node.js, including naming conventions, immutability, error handling, type safety, component structure, custom hooks, state management, API design, file organization, comments, performance optimization, and testing standards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new project, reviewing code, refactoring, setting up linting rules, or onboarding new contributors.

say_en.text: Review the code quality of this React component.
say_en.note: Claude will check against React best practices.

say_en.text: Refactor this function following coding standards.
say_en.note: Claude will apply naming, immutability, etc.

say_en.text: Design a compliant response format for this API endpoint.
say_en.note: Claude will use the ApiResponse interface.
